newsitem.title: UK: Simpson Spence Atlantic Capesize Index rises.
newsitem.headline: Simpson Spence Atlantic Capesize Index rises.

text.p: The Atlantic Capesize Index calculated by the research department of shipbrokers Simpson Spence and Young (SS&Y) rose to 3,291 points on Monday from 3,268 a week ago.

SS&Y said the slight increase in the Index was due to positional factors rather than any clear firming of freight rates. A lack of consistency was apparent for some trans-Atlantic business where vessels in similar positions could command different rates.
